text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: A new face.
zh: 一张新面孔。

text: What brings you here, my child?
zh: 是什么把你带到这里来的，我的孩子？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Where am I?
zh: 我这是在哪儿？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你们在这里做什么？

text: Can you open the temple?
zh: 你能打开神殿吗？

text: Regarding the book...
zh: 关于那本书……

text: You trapped me inside the temple!
zh: 你把我关在神殿里了！

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Take care of yourself, my child.
zh: 照顾好自己，我的孩子。

text: I am #:B'Oldar:#, the leader of this sacred place.
zh: 我是#:博尔达尔:#，这处圣地的领袖。

text: And who am I talking to?
zh: 那么，与我交谈的又是哪位？

text: Just a traveler.
zh: 只是个旅人。

text: A nobody.
zh: 无名之辈。

text: I see...
zh: 原来如此……

text: Then I will not deter you any longer from your travels.
zh: 那我就不再耽搁你的旅程了。

text: So?
zh: 怎么样？

text: You don't seem to be a... #:nobody:#.
zh: 你看起来可不像是……#:无名之辈:#。

text: You seem to be far more. Is that right?
zh: 你远不止如此。我说得对吗？

text:
Please forgive my question.
I'm just very curious.
zh:
请原谅我的提问。
我只是非常好奇。

text: You are in the heart of the Rhoga Swamp.
zh: 你正身处罗加沼泽的深处。

text: However, be careful where you go. There is a fearsome beast lurking around.
zh: 不过，走动时务必小心。附近潜伏着一头可怕的野兽。

text: Especially near the temple.
zh: 尤其是在神殿附近。

text: What temple?
zh: 什么神殿？

text: Which beast?
zh: 什么野兽？

text: That's all I wanted to know.
zh: 我想知道的就这些。

text:
To the east, there is a sacred temple.
It is our mission to protect it by any means.
zh:
东边有一座神圣的神殿。
不惜一切代价守护它，正是我们的使命。

text: In order to protect the temple from outsiders and the beast, we had to seal it.
zh: 为了保护神殿不受外人和野兽的侵扰，我们不得不将它封印。

text: Haven't you heard the rumors about the beast of the swamp?
zh: 你没听说过沼泽野兽的传闻吗？

text: It sneaks up on you... And in the blink of an eye you'll be dead.
zh: 它会悄无声息地接近你……眨眼之间，你就没命了。

text: Many have come here to kill the beast, but no one ever came back.
zh: 许多人来这里猎杀那头野兽，却没有一个人回来过。

text: Even two high-ranking members of the royal guard never returned.
zh: 就连皇家卫队的两位高阶成员也一去不返。

text: Is there anything else?
zh: 还有别的事吗？

text: Open the temple?
zh: 打开神殿？

text: I suppose you could help us with the beast.
zh: 也许你能帮我们对付那头野兽。

text: We managed to trap it inside the temple, but could not defeat it on our own.
zh: 我们设法把它困在了神殿里，却无力凭自己击败它。

text: What do you say?
zh: 你意下如何？

text: I will go into the temple and slay the beast.
zh: 我会进入神殿，斩杀那头野兽。

text: Let me think about that.
zh: 让我考虑一下。

text: Very well...
zh: 很好……

text: I knew you were the one who would defeat the beast.
zh: 我就知道，你就是那个会击败野兽的人。

text: Meet me at the entrance to the temple.
zh: 到神殿入口处与我会合。

text:
No!
The temple remains sealed.
zh:
不行！
神殿必须保持封印。

text: I won't open the door without a good reason.
zh: 没有充分的理由，我是不会开门的。

text: We have given up our simple needs and now serve only our God.
zh: 我们舍弃了世俗的欲求，如今只侍奉我们的神明。

text: This kind of devotion is not tolerated in this land. Many years ago, we decided to move into the swamp.
zh: 这样的虔诚在这片土地上不被容忍。许多年前，我们决定迁入沼泽。

text: Here we are undisturbed and may worship our God in our own way.
zh: 在这里，我们不受打扰，可以用自己的方式敬拜我们的神明。

text: How do you worship?
zh: 你们如何敬拜？

text: Well...
You seem to be afraid of details...
zh: 你似乎不敢深究细节……

text: But don't worry.
zh: 不过别担心。

text: Come here, my child.
zh: 过来吧，我的孩子。

text:
You have been a great help to my brothers.
That should not go unrewarded.
zh:
你帮了我的弟兄们大忙。
这份恩情不该没有回报。

text: I, too, will give you a task that will test your abilities and your enthusiasm.
zh: 我也要交给你一项任务，它将考验你的能力与热忱。

text: Give me your task.
zh: 把任务交给我吧。

text: What is my reward?
zh: 我的报酬是什么？

text: I am not interested.
zh: 我没兴趣。

text:
Your answer disappoints me.
So be it...
zh:
你的回答令我失望。
那就这样吧……

text:
Days ago, I had a vision about an ancient book.
The #:Arcanum Sanguis:#.
zh:
几天前，我在幻象中看到了一本古籍。
#:血之秘典:#。

text: I shall accept you into our ranks provided you carry out your task to my satisfaction.
zh: 只要你把任务完成得让我满意，我就接纳你加入我们的行列。

text: It was stolen from the Academy, north of here.
zh: 它是从北边的魔法学院被偷走的。

text: I want you to find and bring me said book.
zh: 我要你找到那本书，并把它带来给我。

text: Where can I find the book?
zh: 我能在哪里找到那本书？

text: How do you know about it?
zh: 你是怎么知道这本书的？

text: I already returned the book to the Academy.
zh: 我已经把书归还给学院了。

text: I don't want to continue the search.
zh: 我不想继续寻找了。

text: Do you know a Lord Margyott?
zh: 你认识一位马尔乔特领主吗？

text: I know where the book is.
zh: 我知道书在哪里。

text: What do you need for a skeleton key?
zh: 制作万能钥匙需要什么？

text: I have everything needed for a skeleton key.
zh: 制作万能钥匙的材料我都备齐了。

text: Here is the Arcanum Sanguis.
zh: 这就是血之秘典。

text: There's something else I want to talk about.
zh: 我还想谈点别的。

text: Our practices are intended only for the few of us.
zh: 我们的仪轨只属于我们这少数人。

text:
In my vision, I saw the keeper of the Crossroad Inn.
He was part of the theft.
zh:
在幻象中，我看到了十字路旅店的店主。
他参与了那起盗窃。

text: You may want to talk to him about the book.
zh: 你或许该找他谈谈那本书的事。

text:
Also, the mages of the academy are searching for it.
Certainly, they already discovered something.
zh:
另外，学院的法师们也在寻找它。
他们想必已经有所发现。

text: Many years ago I was told about the existence of this book.
zh: 许多年前，就有人告诉过我这本书的存在。

text: However, I was denied access to the academy, and thus to the book.
zh: 然而，学院拒绝我入内，我也因此无缘得见那本书。

text: It seems to me that I was mistaken about you.
zh: 看来，我是看错你了。

text: What is it, my child?
zh: 怎么了，我的孩子？

text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: Are you sure about that?
zh: 你确定吗？

text: Yes.
zh: 确定。

text: No. I am going to find the book.
zh: 不。我会去找那本书的。

text:
Good.
Is there anything else?
zh:
很好。
还有别的事吗？

text:
Indeed.
Though, it is a name I haven't heard for quite some time.
zh:
认识。
不过，这个名字我已经很久没有听到了。

text: Lord Margyott is the ruler of a far away island.
zh: 马尔乔特领主是一座遥远岛屿的统治者。

text:
Excellent!
Where is it?
zh:
好极了！
书在哪里？

text: Of course, they had to lock away the book.
zh: 他们当然得把书锁起来。

text: The book is locked away in a chest.
zh: 书被锁在一个箱子里。

text: Over the years, I have acquired knowledge that seems incomprehensible to many.
zh: 这些年来，我习得了许多常人难以理解的知识。

text: This includes the knowledge of how to make a skeleton key - a key that opens any lock.
zh: 其中就包括万能钥匙的制法——一把能打开任何锁的钥匙。

text: I shall make one for you if you bring me the missing items needed.
zh: 只要你把所缺的材料带来，我就为你做一把。

text: Rumor says no one ever found the island without his invitation.
zh: 传闻说，没有他的邀请，谁也找不到那座岛。

text: I need one #:ore of orichalcum:# and a #:small red gem:# for the ritual.
zh: 仪式需要一块#:山铜矿石:#和一颗#:小块红色宝石:#。

text: For the base of the key, I need the #:bone of a skeleton:#.
zh: 至于钥匙的基底，我需要一根#:骷髅的骨头:#。

text: I will now craft a key out of this bone.
zh: 现在，我就用这根骨头打造一把钥匙。

text: And imbue it with the magic to open any lock.
zh: 再为它注入能开启任何锁的魔力。

text:
Take this key and retrieve the Arcanum Sanguis.
Be aware, that the key may only be used once.
zh:
拿上这把钥匙，去取回血之秘典。
切记，这把钥匙只能使用一次。

text:
Incredible... This artifact will take our cult in a new direction.
I must thank you, my child.
zh:
不可思议……这件圣物将引领我们的教团走向新的方向。
我必须感谢你，我的孩子。

text:
You have proven yourself to be a valuable member of our cult.
That should not go unrewarded.
zh:
你已经证明了自己是教团宝贵的一员。
这份功劳不该没有回报。

text:
Meet me in front of the temple, which is located east of here.
I will share our secrets with you.
zh:
到东边的神殿前与我会合。
我会与你分享我们的秘密。

text: Yes indeed.
zh: 没错。

text:
We realized that you could soon become a threat to us and the temple.
So we decided to lock you inside it.
zh:
我们意识到，你很快就会成为我们和神殿的威胁。
所以我们决定把你锁在里面。

text: To my amazement, you seemed to be able to escape the dangers of the temple, as well as the temple itself.
zh: 令我惊讶的是，你不仅躲过了神殿中的重重危险，还从神殿本身逃了出来。

text:
We must have misjudged you.
This strength must not perish inside the temple.
zh:
我们一定是看走眼了。
这样的力量绝不该消亡在神殿之中。

text: No! This power should better join our community and grow even stronger!
zh: 不！这股力量更应该加入我们的社群，变得愈发强大！

text: You are crazy!
zh: 你疯了！

text: Sounds great!
zh: 听起来不错！

text: Are you sure you want to have your back on me and the community?
zh: 你确定要背弃我和整个社群吗？

text: Very well!
zh: 很好！

text: Yes. I don't want anything to do with you.
zh: 是的。我不想和你们扯上任何关系。

text: No. I want to join the cult.
zh: 不。我想加入教团。

text: Well then. Apparently we were not mistaken about you.
zh: 那好。看来我们没有看错你。

text: From now on you are no longer welcome here!
zh: 从今往后，这里不再欢迎你！

text: Everyone in our community had to pass a test to demonstrate will and dedication.
zh: 我们社群中的每个人都必须通过考验，以证明自己的意志与奉献。

text: As you can no longer serve our community, you are no longer welcome here.
zh: 既然你已无法再为我们的社群效力，这里也不再欢迎你。

text:
Meet me in inside the temple, which is located east of here.
I will share our secrets with you.
zh:
到东边的神殿里与我会合。
我会与你分享我们的秘密。

text: Your strength would be a great asset to our community. However, in a vision, I saw you entrusting a relict important to our cult to the wrong people.
zh: 你的力量本可以成为我们社群的一大助力。然而，我在幻象中看到，你把对教团至关重要的圣物托付给了不该托付的人。
